description: This PHP script generates the detailed view page for an 'Accounts' module in a CRM system, handling data retrieval, permissions, UI components, and related list management.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class for CRM entities, used to retrieve and manipulate account data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template class for rendering CRM views.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents a web service object in Vtiger CRM, used for email field retrieval.

classes.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta
classes.description: Metadata class for CRM objects, used to get email fields.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record ID.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Fetches UI blocks for the detail view.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Generates update information for the record.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the module.

methods.name: useInternalMailer
methods.description: Checks if internal mailer is enabled.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for various actions.

methods.name: VtigerWebserviceObject::fromName
methods.description: Creates a web service object from module name.

methods.name: VtigerCRMObjectMeta::getEmailFields
methods.description: Retrieves email fields for the CRM object.

methods.name: fetchWordTemplateList
methods.description: Fetches list of Word templates for mail merge.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID for a module.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into components.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions for action buttons.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if related lists are present.

methods.name: get_use_asterisk
methods.description: Determines if asterisk should be used in UI.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Retrieves related lists for the module.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession::addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to session for UI state.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession::getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Gets list of related modules from session.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks field-level permissions.

methods.name: markAsViewed
methods.description: Marks the record as viewed for notifications.

methods.name: Vtiger_Link::getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of specified types for the module.

methods.name: PerformancePrefs::getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves boolean performance preferences.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Handles record navigation in detail view.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data.
